versions.changelog:
- Added "suite_url" metadata and clarified the skill is part of the Overpowered suite.
- Minor wording and structural improvements to the SKILL.md introduction.
- Changed section header to "# Overpowered / What Changed" for clearer context.
- Removed the file "skill-card.md".

Initial release—explains what-changed skill for meaningful change assessment beyond line-by-line diffs.

- Outlines the core rule: report changes in meaning and consequence, not just text.
- Provides step-by-step procedure for comparing versions of evolving artifacts (e.g., policies, configs, datasets).
- Defines classification for each change (e.g., material, breaking, compatible, editorial).
- Specifies an output contract for clear, practical reporting and an actionable summary.
- Includes guidance on handling edge cases and prioritizing by impact.
- Stresses importance of semantic analysis, normalization of format-only edits, and bounding the scope of conclusions.
